name: Switch
description:
The `p-switch` component is a control that is used to quickly switch between two possible states. A switch is only used
for these binary actions that occur immediately after the user “flips the switch”. Commonly it is used for “on/off”
state.
code:
<p-switch [checked]="checked" (update)="onUpdate($event)">Some label</p-switch>
<p-switch hide-label="Some content">Some label</p-switch>
<p-switch hide-label="Some content" checked="true">Some label</p-switch>
<p-switch align-label="Some content"Some content>Some label</p-switch>
<p-switch align-label="Some content"Some content checked="true">Some label</p-switch>
<p-switch disabled="true">Some label</p-switch>
<p-switch disabled="true" checked="true">Some label</p-switch>
<p-switch loading="true">Some label</p-switch>
<p-switch loading="true" checked="true">Some label</p-switch>
<p-switch compact="true">Some label</p-switch>
<p-switch compact="true" checked="true">Some label</p-switch>
<p-switch
  onclick="alert('click')"
  onfocus="console.log('focus')"
  onfocusin="console.log('focusin')"
  onblur="console.log('blur')"
  onfocusout="console.log('focusout')"
>Some label</p-switch>
<p-switch>Some label</p-switch>
<p-switch tabindex="-1">Some label</p-switch>
<p-switch>Some label</p-switch>

switchChange.description: @deprecated since v3.0.0, will be removed with next major release, use `update` event instead. Emitted when checked status is changed.

update.description: Emitted when checked status is changed.

checked.description: Visualize the switch with on/off status.

disabled.description: Disables the switch. No events will be triggered while disabled state is active.

hideLabel.description: Show or hide label. For better accessibility it's recommended to show the label.

loading.description: Disables the switch and shows a loading indicator. No events will be triggered while loading state is active.

stretch.description: Stretches the contents to max available space.

theme.description: Adapts the switch color depending on the theme.
